standard_prerequisites.name: Sberlo--Shpilka weight distribution bounds
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact author Theorems2.1/2.2[13] and parameter footnote retained.

core_obligations: Preserve growing-parameter regime, constant epsilon and small absolute degree fraction.
Retain complete first-moment/weight-bin proof, including both technical claim cases.
Group direct Reed-Muller erasure/error consequences with main result, preserving capped-channel definitions and author derivations.
difficulty_reason: The authors estimate the expected vanishing-space size by a weighted sum over polynomials. Splitting biased polynomials into low- and medium-weight bins lets precise weight-distribution bounds control both tails, forcing minimal dimension; generator/parity-check duality then yields the coding consequences.

dedup.scope: Root complete identity refresh for formal DOI, arxiv2205.10749, standard arXiv DOI and ECCC TR22-075 across old corpus/prepared/both lines yielded zero matches. Main result and direct Reed-Muller consequences are grouped, with no support/parameter splitting.
